snippet.title: Psychomachia - Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🕹️ Play Zombiemachia on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3240000/Zombiemachia/
🌐 Kornux Industries : http://kornuxindustries.com

Confront your deepest fears in Psychomachia, trapped in a nightmarish loop at the heart of the dorms of mental instability. Explore the intricacies of the human mind, faced with terrifying manifestations of madness.
